---
title: "Installation"
---

Install `attaviz` from PyPI.

## With uv

```bash
uv add attaviz
```

## With pip

```bash
pip install attaviz
```

For choropleth maps, install the optional GeoPandas support:

```bash
uv add "attaviz[maps]"
# or
pip install "attaviz[maps]"
```

Keep the extra in quotes so shells do not expand the brackets.

## Requirements

- Python 3.9 or newer
- Altair 5 or newer

Dependencies (`altair`, `pandas`, `pyarrow`, `vegafusion`, `vl-convert-python`) install
automatically.

## Local development

Clone and install the dev environment:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/datapartnership/attaviz.git
cd attaviz
uv sync --all-groups
```

Run the project checks:

```bash
uv run pytest -q
uv run ruff check .
uv run ruff format --check .
```

Install [Quarto](https://quarto.org/docs/get-started/) separately, then render
the documentation with `uv run quarto render docs`.
